verdict.rationale: Keycloak is fully open-source and explicitly documented to be self-hosted via Docker container image, container operator, or standalone distribution, with first-party quickstart docs and community reports confirming years of production self-hosted deployments. Minor gaps: no explicit license text cited and community notes highlight operational overhead (memory, complexity) as caveats to self-hosting at scale. Missing for 10: explicit license/source-repo citation, more independent verification of ease of self-hosting.
